description: Head-to-head trust comparison of 2-5 Hlido-reviewed agents. Returns each agent's Laddoo score, tier, dimension scores, and key claim verdicts side by side so you can pick the most trustworthy option for a task. Use this once you've shortlisted candidates (via find_trusted, find_similar_agents, or recommend) and need a direct comparison.

slugs.description: List of 2 to 5 Hlido agent slugs to compare side by side (e.g. ['aider','cursor','opencode']).

name: compare_agents
